tasks.label: Remove extra venv folders (cmd)
args: if exist .venv rmdir /s /q .venv & if exist ml_backend\venv rmdir /s /q ml_backend\venv

tasks.label: Health check APIs
args: $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Write-Host '---5000 root---'; try { (Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://localhost:5000/' -TimeoutSec 5).StatusCode } catch { $_.Exception.Message }; Write-Host '---5000 api/complaints---'; try { (Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://localhost:5000/api/complaints' -TimeoutSec 8).StatusCode } catch { $_.Exception.Message }; Write-Host '---8000 root---'; try { (Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/' -TimeoutSec 8).StatusCode } catch { $_.Exception.Message }; Write-Host '---8000 docs---'; try { (Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs' -TimeoutSec 8).StatusCode } catch { $_.Exception.Message }

tasks.label: Inspect port 8000 process
args: echo ---netstat--- && netstat -ano | findstr :8000 && echo ---tasklist--- && for /f "tokens=5" %a in ('netstat -ano ^| findstr :8000 ^| findstr LISTENING') do @tasklist /fi "PID eq %a"

tasks.label: Inspect port 8000 process (ps)
args: Write-Host "---netstat---"; netstat -ano | Select-String ":8000"; Write-Host "---owners---"; $pids = (netstat -ano | Select-String ":8000" | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split "\s+")[-1] } | Select-Object -Unique); foreach ($pid in $pids) { try { Get-Process -Id $pid | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, Path } catch { Write-Host "PID $pid not found" } }

tasks.label: Simple 8000 diagnostics
args: echo ---netstat--- && netstat -ano | findstr 8000 && echo ---python processes--- && tasklist | findstr python

tasks.label: Recheck API health
args: Write-Host '---5000 root---'; try { (Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://localhost:5000/' -TimeoutSec 5).StatusCode } catch { $_.Exception.Message }; Write-Host '---8000 root---'; try { (Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/' -TimeoutSec 5).StatusCode } catch { $_.Exception.Message }; Write-Host '---8000 predict check---'; try { (Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs' -TimeoutSec 5).StatusCode } catch { $_.Exception.Message }

tasks.label: Test ML predict endpoint
args: $form = @{ description = 'pothole near hospital road'; image = Get-Item 'fire.jpg' }; try { $resp = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/predict' -Method Post -Form $form -TimeoutSec 20; Write-Host $resp.StatusCode; $resp.Content } catch { $_.Exception.Message }
